lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Operating sequence from field record to financing. Four wheat contracts, the 2027 pool, Token-2022 WHEAT-2027 and one Devnet primary placement are proven on Solana Devnet. Minted 1,000; placed 10; 990 remain in Registrar inventory.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.intro: CommoChain Ltd operates this investment token platform. Field to Finance is the agriculture asset protocol demonstrated here: rights to future agricultural production can be digitally verified, pooled, risk-adjusted, tokenized and financed.
dashboard.infrastructureNote: Read-only Solana Devnet status. Eligible coverage remains the operating view. Token figures are secondary.
dashboard.regulatorIntro: Market supervision: status, issued instruments, concepts still in structuring, and exceptions. This workspace does not execute market actions.
dashboard.registrarIntro: WHEAT-2027 minted supply, Registrar inventory and the settled primary placement.
dashboard.producerIntro: Own fields, contracts and monitoring only.
dashboard.scasIntro: Attestation, matching and coverage source status. SCAS does not mint.
dashboard.investorIntro: WHEAT-2027 is the issued demonstrator instrument of the Field to Finance agriculture protocol. The secondary market is not open. An asset investment and a protocol investment are different instruments.
dashboard.traderIntro: Institutional portal into one Market Core. Matching and clearing are separate. The secondary market is not open.
dashboard.complianceIntro: Application-level participant screening. Provider results remain DEMO / SIMULATED except cryptographic wallet ownership.
dashboard.issuerIntro: Eligible agricultural backing, issuance capacity and primary placement progress. Registrar inventory is shown as operating context.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Phase 4: ISS-001 minted 1,000 WHEAT-2027. One Devnet primary placement of 10 units is settled. 990 remain in Registrar inventory. Cap 8,300 t. The public app does not mint, burn or place.
tokens.hypothesis: Demo working hypothesis — not a legally approved term sheet. Partner answers on instrument type, issuer and redemption remain open.
tokens.claimBoundary: WHEAT-2027 is a Commodity Agricultural Token. The holder has a claim against the Issuer, not direct legal ownership of a farmer’s wheat, not a claim on an individual Producer, not farm equity, and not ownership of the underlying DAC.
tokens.issueTooltip: Minted tokens exist. The public app does not sign. Further minting stays with the Registrar.
tokens.burnTooltip: Burn is a Registrar action after redemption. The public app does not burn.
tokens.issueNote: Mint and burn are Registrar actions. They stay disabled in the public app. Administrative mint creation runs from a WSL script.
tokens.notDeployedNote: No Token-2022 mint, mint authority or issuance transaction is recorded.
tokens.supplyNotSold: Minted supply is not the same as tokens placed with investors. 1,000 minted does not mean 1,000 sold.
tokens.supplyIntro: Coverage capacity is the economic cap. Minted supply is the Token-2022 total. Placed and circulating change only after primary placement.
tokens.issuanceIntro: Technical Devnet placement demonstrator. Commercial placement is not publicly open.

mintProof.holdingNote: Registrar inventory is the unsold minted balance. Placed tokens are held by the investor after atomic DvP.

scas.title: Attestation
scas.description: SCAS attests fields, digital agricultural contracts, monitoring, scoring, pool lock and coverage inputs. It matches Issuer and Producer into a digital agricultural contract. It does not mint, burn or match investment orders.
scas.boundary: Attestation is an SCAS operator action. Minting and primary placement are Registrar / Market actions. SCAS does not mint, burn, place tokens or hold investor funds.

marketCore.notMarket: POOL-WHEAT-2027-01 is Field to Finance backing infrastructure, not a market.

marketCore.protocolInvestmentFlags: NO OFFERING · NOT ISSUED · NOT ADMITTED

marketCore.platformNotToken: The platform is market infrastructure, not a token type.
marketCore.issuedHoldingsProof: Figures below are issued-instrument demonstrator proof, not the definition of this registry.
marketCore.demonstratorOnly: Technology demonstrator. Not an AFSA permission or admission.
marketCore.protocolWorld: What economic world this protocol represents
marketCore.protocolPath: How raw asset rights become an investment instrument
marketCore.f2fModules: Agriculture-specific modules. They are not global platform concepts.
marketCore.protocolInvestmentNote: An investment in an asset and an investment in the protocol itself are different instruments, with different rights and risks.
marketCore.noFakeEconomics: No offer, price, yield or term is shown. Economics are not invented.
marketCore.spvNotRequired: An SPV is not implied as legally required for every future protocol.
marketCore.basisAgriculture: Agriculture-specific basis. Market Core does not interpret soil, wells, royalties or game inventory.
marketCore.basisUnavailable: This protocol has no economic-basis adapter yet.
marketCore.riskNote: Risk haircut applies to issuance capacity. It is not a legal pledge of an individual farmer’s crop unless issuance terms say otherwise.
marketCore.marketClosed: Secondary LIMIT market is open for the WHEAT-2027 demonstrator. Legal ownership does not change until Devnet settlement.
marketCore.clearingDistinct: Market records who traded. Clearing records whether obligations became final.
marketCore.notSecondaryClearing: This is not a secondary-market clearing event.
marketCore.clearingIntro: Clearing is first-class market infrastructure. It is separate from matching and from the registrar book of record.
marketCore.registryIntro: The registrar remains the legal book of record in the current architecture. Individual disclosed holder versus omnibus / nominee custody is unresolved.
marketCore.unresolvedCustody: Custody model unresolved: disclosed holder vs omnibus / nominee.
marketCore.instrumentsIntro: Issued instruments and concepts on Market Core. Protocol-specific backing modules are not independently tradeable instruments.
marketCore.admissionIntro: Platform governance stages. This wording is not a claim that AFSA requires each step in this form. Formal regulatory permission is separate from platform workflow.
marketCore.supervisionIntro: Exceptions and status. This view does not execute market actions.
marketCore.closedSecondary: DEMO OPEN · matching on · settlement off
marketCore.differentModels: Verification models differ by protocol and are not identical.

marketCore.legalOwnership: Legal ownership is unchanged until Devnet settlement.
marketCore.bookOfRecord: Registrar / Registry = registered ownership (book of record). Blockchain balances are settlement proof, not the legal register by themselves.
marketCore.reconciliationOk: No exception. Pre-settlement expected 990 / 10 / 0 in the registrar book and on Devnet for mapped ATAs.
marketCore.reconciliationException: Mismatch between registered ownership and live Devnet balances, or live RPC was unavailable.
marketCore.reconciliationSourceLive: Chain source: LIVE_RPC (Solana Devnet). Cached proof is not treated as chain truth.
marketCore.reconciliationSourceCached: Chain source: CACHED_PROOF only. Not sufficient for settlement approval.
marketCore.grainDeskUnmapped: Grain Desk has no mapped Solana wallet and no WHEAT / DEMO-KZT ATA. 5B.2 must designate a wallet and create ATAs on-chain.
marketCore.protocolVersionIntro: Protocol rules are immutable by version. An instrument keeps a permanent reference to the exact version it was created under and does not follow later versions.
marketCore.boundAtIssuance: Bound at issuance. This instrument does not follow later protocol versions.
marketCore.notBoundToProtocolVersion: Not bound to a protocol version.
marketCore.governanceNoteF2FV1_1: First recorded version of the Field to Finance demonstrator protocol. No formal legal or governance activation date has been established, and none is claimed: activation and freeze dates are deliberately left unset rather than assumed. The rules of this version are immutable — instruments issued under it keep this exact reference and do not follow later versions.
marketCore.protocolsIntro: Every asset protocol recorded on Commodity Chain. Field to Finance is the active demonstrator protocol. Water, Music Rights and Gaming Assets are structuring or concept work with no recorded protocol version, no instrument and no market.
marketCore.noBoundInstruments: No instrument is bound to this version.
marketCore.notIssuedNote: Not issued. No offer, price, yield or admission.
marketCore.economicsWithheldNotIssued: This instrument is not issued, so no offer, price, yield or term is shown. That is not a rejection.
marketCore.basisDataUnavailable: Economic-basis evidence is not recorded for this instrument.
marketCore.basisUnavailableForInstrumentFamily: This instrument family has no recorded economic basis.
marketCore.termsNotOffered: This instrument is not offered. No terms, price, yield or redemption promise is shown.
marketCore.termsUnavailable: No terms are recorded for this instrument.
marketCore.riskNotRecorded: No protocol-specific risk metrics are recorded.
marketCore.riskNotOffered: Offering risk metrics are not shown because this instrument is not offered.
marketCore.noMarketRecorded: No market is recorded for this instrument.
marketCore.marketNotOffered: No market is available. This instrument is not offered and not admitted.
marketCore.marketPhaseClosed: A market record exists and is closed.
marketCore.clearingNotRecorded: No clearing event is recorded for this instrument.
marketCore.clearingNotOffered: Clearing is not available. This instrument is not offered and has no market.
marketCore.secondaryMarketOpenDemonstrator: A secondary LIMIT market is open for this demonstrator instrument. Matching does not change legal ownership.
marketCore.matchingDoesNotChangeOwnership: Matching does not change legal ownership. FILLED is not SETTLED.
marketCore.tokenProofIsDemonstratorEvidence: On-chain token proof is demonstrator evidence. It is not legal ownership and not settlement finality.
marketCore.holdingsNotRecorded: No holdings are recorded for this instrument.

eligibility.summaryEligible: New-order admission is available for this participant and instrument.
eligibility.summaryNotEligible: The current assessment does not permit new orders.
eligibility.summaryNotAssessed: No assessment is recorded for this participant and instrument.
eligibility.summaryPolicyPending: Policy treatment is pending; new orders are unavailable.
eligibility.summaryAttributionIncomplete: Eligibility information is incomplete; new orders fail closed.
eligibility.summaryInconsistent: Eligibility information is inconsistent; new orders fail closed.
eligibility.summaryNoParticipant: View-only market access. No trading participant identity is resolved.
eligibility.gapPlaceholderParticipant: This row is a placeholder participant, not an admitted participant.
eligibility.gapPlaceholderInstrument: This row refers to a placeholder instrument, not an issued instrument.
eligibility.inconsistencyWrongOrganization: The actor organisation does not match the recorded participant organisation.
eligibility.inconsistencyAssessmentStateMismatch: The recorded assessment does not match the current eligibility state.
eligibility.inconsistencyAssessmentPairMismatch: The assessment does not apply to this participant and instrument.
eligibility.inconsistencyReasonCodeMismatch: The recorded reason does not match the assessment.
eligibility.inconsistencyAuthorityRoleNotAllowed: The recorded authority role is not permitted to assess eligibility.
eligibility.onboardingDoesNotGrantEligibility: Onboarding approval does not itself grant instrument eligibility.
eligibility.screeningVersusEligibility: Compliance screening and instrument eligibility are separate decisions.
eligibility.screeningNotInstrumentAuthorization: Screening is not authorization to trade a particular instrument.
eligibility.fixtureDisclaimer: Recorded demo eligibility is shown for inspection. It is not a persisted regulatory decision.
eligibility.newOrderPrecheck: New-order availability is a fail-closed precheck. Persistent market writes remain authorized at the market core boundary.

origination.wizardLead: Producer-declared data. SCAS verification comes later and does not overwrite this record.
origination.actionContinueDraft: Continue the draft, then submit to SCAS.
origination.actionRespond: SCAS asked for corrections. Upload the replacement and resubmit.
origination.actionVerified: Verified field snapshot is on the book.
origination.queueLead: SCAS reviews producer-declared land against its own sources. This desk does not write a DAC or a chain transaction.
origination.queueEmptyBody: When a producer submits a field, the case appears on this desk.
origination.queueStorageBody: The verification queue could not be read. This is not an empty desk.
origination.monitoringSoon: Monitoring stays on the producer monitoring desk. No live satellite API is connected here.
origination.contractsSoon: A verified field is not a DAC. SCAS prepares a draft; Producer and Issuer must confirm terms before the contract is executed. An executed DAC is not an investment token.
origination.dacOpenDraftLead: Prepare a DAC draft from this verified snapshot. SCAS verification does not create the investment token, and does not by itself transfer contractual rights.
origination.dacQueueLead: Digital Agricultural Contracts between Producer and Issuer. SCAS prepares and verifies; it is not the rights holder. A DAC is not a token, pool, issuance or chain object.
origination.dacEmptyBody: When a field is verified, SCAS can open a DAC draft from the snapshot.
origination.intakeLead: Review executed DAC packages. Accepting intake does not create a pool, token, issuance, placement or chain write.
origination.intakeEmptyBody: When SCAS submits an executed DAC, it appears on this desk.
origination.dacNotAToken: Verified field ≠ DAC draft ≠ executed DAC ≠ investment token. Accept does not mint, pool or place.
origination.noDacYet: No DAC draft is open for this field.
origination.issuerQueueLead: Confirm or return exact DAC terms assigned to this issuer. SCAS verification does not itself create the investment token.
origination.issuerEmptyBody: When SCAS assigns this issuer on a draft and sends it for confirmation, it appears here.
origination.demoConfirmation: Demo electronic confirmation. This is not a qualified electronic signature.
origination.stageLegend: Verified field ≠ DAC draft ≠ executed DAC ≠ investment token.
origination.helpLead: Platform help, getting started and support requests open in a later phase. Verification conversation with SCAS stays on the field case.
origination.onboardingHint: Next on this desk: add a field, upload land documents, submit to SCAS.
origination.error: This action could not be completed.
origination.storageUnavailable: Origination is not connected. A server-only SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY is required.

secondary.title: Secondary market
secondary.intro: Institutional LIMIT market for WHEAT-2027. Settlement asset is DEMO-KZT with no monetary value. Matching is price-time priority. Execution uses the resting order price.
secondary.matchedNotSettled: FILLED is not SETTLED. MATCHED does not change registrar ownership. DvP remains pending.
secondary.limitOnly: LIMIT orders. Whole tokens only. Direct MTP channel.
secondary.wholeTokens: Quantity must be a whole WHEAT token. Price is integer DEMO-KZT per token.
secondary.viewOnly: This role may view the market. It cannot submit or cancel orders.
secondary.awaitingDevnet: This phase stops before real blockchain DvP. Trades must not be labelled SETTLED.
secondary.ceremonyHelp: Registrar / regulator only. The control remains disabled until a later approved execution phase.
secondary.ceremonyDisabled: settle_secondary_dvp is implemented in source and tests only. Devnet settlement is not armed. No SETTLE action is available to participants.
secondary.cancelledNotice: Remaining quantity cancelled. Filled quantity stays reserved until settlement.
secondary.coverageNotGuarantee: Coverage and verification reduce / reflect risk. They are not guarantees.
secondary.noDirectFarmerOwnership: The holder has a claim against the Issuer according to instrument terms. This does not imply direct ownership of a farmer’s wheat.
secondary.riskModelValue: Off-chain risk haircut on pooled contracts
secondary.insuranceValue: Demo-simulated pool haircut. Not a guarantee.
secondary.pendingTransfer: Pending: Steppe out 2 · Grain Desk in 2. Legal owned is unchanged.
secondary.admissionPrecheck: This explanation is a fail-closed precheck. Persistent submission remains authorized at the market core write boundary.
